settings.text: Whether you’re visiting the lab, using a drop-off box, or mailing-in ... ordering is simple:

settings.title: Visit Us in Person
settings.text: Swing by the lab during our lab-reception hours and our friendly team will place your order.

settings.title: Use a Film Drop-Off Box
settings.text:
Can’t visit during our lab reception hours? Submit your order online and drop your film at one of our drop boxes — including our 24/7 drop box outside the lab.
Full location details and drop-off guide here.

settings.title: Mail It In
settings.text: Ordering from farther away? Submit your order online and post your film to us. Step-by-step mailing guide click here.

settings.title: Stay Updated
settings.text: However your rolls arrive, we’ll keep you updated at every stage: when your film has been received, when processing is in-progress, and when your scans are ready to download.

settings.category_title: Step By Step Online Order Guide (for Drop-off Box or Mail-in Orders)
settings.question_1: Use our online order form to create your order. Select the drop-off box you are using (or select 'Mail In' for postal orders)
settings.answer_1: Letting us know the drop-off box location tells us which box we need to visit to collect your film!
settings.answer_2: Select the film type, and number of rolls
settings.answer_3: Select from Social, Standard (Large) or Pro (XL) scans. Select a scanner, or leave it to our defaults ... our standard scans are anything but standard!
settings.answer_4:
For drop-off box orders, submit your order at the same time you put your rolls in the box. For mail-in orders, submit your order before posting.

Your order notification lets us know that we have film to collect (or film on the way in the mail).
settings.question_5: We'll send you a payment link
settings.answer_5: Once your rolls reach the lab, we'll send you a payment link and get development underway.

settings.title: Pick Your Film & Scan Size
settings.content: We process C41 (Colour Negative), B&W, and ECN-2 (Cine) film in 35mm and 120 formats.

settings.title: Choose Your Scanner & Preferences
settings.content:
Scanner
We scan on our beautiful Noritsu scanner by default. Prefer a different look? Choose another classic scanner: the FujiFilm Frontier (Socials, Classic, or Pro) or Kodak Pakon (Socials only).

Scan Preferences
For Classic and Pro scans, you can select your contrast preference —or leave it to our standard lab finishing. Either way, every roll is scanned consistently to our premium quality.

settings.title: Decide What Happens to Your Negatives
settings.content: By default, we cut negatives into strips of six and sleeve them for collection. Prefer uncut or mailed to you ? Just let us know. View our full negative-handling info Click Here.

settings.title: Select payment & Submit Order
settings.content: Either Pay when placing your order, or select ‘pay later’ and we’ll send a payment link once your rolls reach the lab and are checked against your order.

settings.title: Stay Updated
settings.content: We’ll keep you posted at every stage—when your order’s in-progress, when scans ready to download, and when your negatives are ready to pick up.
